name: Hue trip
author: Ambrotype
description: Psychedelic colour: every colour turned round the colour wheel, more the brighter it is, so the tones become a rainbow; with stronger colour and posterised bands. A colour effect, so it is as quick as a LUT.

params.name: turn
params.label: Turn
params.description: How far every colour turns round the wheel, in degrees.

params.name: cycles
params.label: Rainbow
params.description: How many times round the wheel from black to white: 0 turns every tone the same.

params.name: colour
params.label: Colour
params.description: How strong the colours are; 100 is as they were.

params.name: bands
params.label: Posterise
params.description: Flat bands of tone, like a screen print; 0 is smooth.

params.name: paint
params.label: Paint
params.description: A rainbow by tone painted over, so greys and dull colours change too.
